notes.title: Addictive Text-based Military themed MMO RPG Coming soon to Steam !
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33558674/8f1b4200aeac15645dac5cdb9fd59c482806aebe.png[/img]

After a great success in other platforms, BattleCry: World At War is making its way to Steam. 

[h1]We aim to redefine the way the Text-Based games are played! [/h1]

BattleCry: World At War is a [b]Text-Based online multiplayer role-playing[/b] game (Yeah, you heard it right!) where you team up with other players to build your military might and dominate the battlefield. 

[b]Increase your influence and firepower[/b] by recruiting and expanding your army, navy, air-force and most importantly Captains to lead them. There's opportunity in every front and make sure you take the right decisions.

[b]Join and Coordinate your strategies[/b] with your Alliance and fellow commanders by using our new [b]chat system[/b] where you can communicate in real time.

The fun and opportunities are endless!
